text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bump into Tokai Teio as she's trudging
along
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Why do we have another health checkup today?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look at me! I'm the picture of health!
It's
a total
waste of time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the checkup room is sooo cramped!
And
everyone's dressed in white with
this super serious
look on their face...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll sit in your office and do nothing for
you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we can't switch places, so
Tokai
Teio lumbers to her checkup,
sighing as she goes.
